This is main resources site for the Computational Statistics course. This is
where all the material, including slides, assignments, and data, are collected.

## Schedule

Times and rooms are checked daily against the [official KU
timetable](`r timetable_url`). All times are local to Copenhagen.

**Note on the exercises:**

Each Thursday, our exercise session will center around a key topic. Together,
we'll work through selected exercises on this topic. The remaining exercises are
for you to solve independently at your own pace.

### Week 1

#### Lecture 1: Introduction

`r session_info("2026-09-01")`

- **Slides:** [Introduction and Functions in R](slides/lecture1.pdf)
  ([source](https://github.com/math-ku/compstat/blob/main/slides/lecture1.qmd))
- **Reading:** [Chapter 6 (AdvR)](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/functions.html)
- **Exercises:** [A1-A7 (CSWR, Appendix
  A)](https://cswr.nrhstat.org/app-r#app-ex)
  - **Data:** [`infrared.txt`](data/infrared.txt)

#### Exercise Session 1

`r session_info("2026-09-03", "Theoretical Exercises")`

- **Main topic**: Setting up a proper development environment for R/Rcpp
- **In class walkthrough**: A1-A7 (CSwR, Appendix A)
- **Solutions**: [Exercise 1 Solutions](exercises/U1.qmd)

#### Lecture 2: OOP and Density Estimation

`r session_info("2026-09-03")`

- **Slides:** [OOP and Density Estimation](slides/lecture2.pdf)

- **Reading:**

  - [A7-A10](https://cswr.nrhstat.org/app-r#app-ex) (CSwR, Appendix A)

### Week 2

#### Lecture 3: Measuring and Improving Performance

`r session_info("2026-09-08")`

- **Slides:** [Measuring and Improving Performance](slides/lecture3.pdf)
  ([source](https://github.com/math-ku/compstat/blob/main/slides/lecture3.qmd))
- **Reading:** [Chapter 23](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/perf-measure.html) and
  [Chapter 24](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/perf-improve.html) (Advanced R)
- **Exercises:** [1-3 (Section 24.4.3,
  AdvR)](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/perf-improve.html#exercises-71)

#### Exercise Session 2

`r session_info("2026-09-10", "Theoretical Exercises")`

- **Main topic**: Using AI properly, memory usage and benchmarking, dependency
  injection, reverse engineering
- **In class walkthrough:** Exercises 2.1-2.6 (CSwR, Chapter 2) + 24.4.3.2 +
  24.4.3.3 (AdvR)
- **Solutions**: [Exercise 2 Solutions](exercises/U2.qmd)
- **Mini-slides**: [Tips for using AI](slides/llm_use.pdf)

#### Lecture 4: Parallelization and Scatterplot Smoothing

`r session_info("2026-09-10")`

- **Slides:** [Parallelization and Scatterplot Smoothing](slides/lecture4.pdf)
  ([source](https://github.com/math-ku/compstat/blob/main/slides/lecture4.qmd))
- **Reading:**
  - [Chapter 3, but skip 3.3 (CSwR)](https://cswr.nrhstat.org/bivariate.html)
  - [Chapter 4, but skip 4.2-4.3
    (CSwR)](https://cswr.nrhstat.org/timeseries.html)
- **Exercises:** [3.4 (Chapter 3,
  CSwR)](https://cswr.nrhstat.org/bivariate#bivariate:ex)
